goal: Show the 78 Owner-approved Vietnamese card names in the Vietnamese app, keeping the original English name as the canonical name.en and alongside the Vietnamese name.
successCriteria: packages/content/data/tarot-cards.json name.vi holds the 78 names from docs/content-review/tarot-card-names-vi.md (Owner approved 2026-10-30, all proposed options) and name.en and every other field are unchanged.
scripts/validate-data.mjs requires an accented Vietnamese name.vi that differs from name.en instead of mirroring it; deck visual-prompt titles still mirror name.en.

docs/CONTENT_SAFETY_STYLE_GUIDE.md Tarot Names section describes the new rule: Vietnamese UI shows the Vietnamese name with the English name beside it; prose may use either; card ids and AI context keep name.en.

Admin content seed and supabase/seed.generated.sql are regenerated from the data with LF-normalized reads (as on the Linux CI checkout), and the Admin workflow catalog source digests for apps/mobile/App.tsx (already stale since earlier PRs) and tarot-cards.json are refreshed; no seed is applied to a database.
npm run validate:data, npm run admin:check, npm --workspace apps/mobile run check and the mobile Jest suite pass, and a web check shows a Vietnamese card name with the English name in the meta line.
untouchedSurfaces: App code, including apps/mobile/App.tsx and features/tarot, is unchanged: the app already reads localizedText(card.name) and displayTarotCardMeta adds the English name when it differs.
Existing Vietnamese prose that mentions English card names (intros, meanings) is not rewritten in this task.
Edge Functions are not deployed and no seed SQL is run; the server keeps its bundled copy until an Owner-approved deploy.
scripts/generate-tarot-data.mjs is an obsolete baseline generator (unaccented Vietnamese) and is not updated; running it would overwrite far more than names.
Draft learning content in docs/content-review stays uncommitted and out of the data.

impact.entryPoint: Every Vietnamese screen that shows a card name: Today card, Tarot draw and result, card meaning, Journal snapshots, Explore library, Oracle handoff text.
impact.dataWrite: No storage change. Saved readings matched by name already accept name.en or name.vi; ids stay the same.
impact.backendContract: No payload change; the app sends card ids. The Edge Function bundles tarot-cards.json, so after a future approved deploy the AI context will carry both names; its prompt already says to keep proper card names unchanged.
impact.canonicalContract: CONTENT_SAFETY_STYLE_GUIDE Tarot Names section and the validate-data name rule change together, per Owner decision 2026-10-30.
impact.adminVisibility: Admin content seed shows the Vietnamese names after the next Admin staging deploy from main.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; name.vi returns to the English names.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: Prose rewrites, per-topic meanings and astrology notes are separate tasks.
impact.agentHandoff: The delivery agent owns only the writeScope, runs the validation commands, commits onto PR #8 branch, and does not merge, deploy or run SQL.

canonicalContracts: Owner decision 2026-10-30 in chat: add Vietnamese card names after reviewing the 78-name table; Owner approved the table as proposed on 2026-10-30.
docs/CONTENT_SAFETY_STYLE_GUIDE.md Tarot Names section, updated by this task.
